comment: ANCHOR: PREFLIGHT_UPLOAD_20261105 — operator D50 item 4: scripts/preflight_upload.py refuses an upload
when tests were not run green at the exact head (validated per-file receipt bound to a clean committed
source), a new test is unregistered, the PR lacks its plain-English answers, origin/main would conflict, a
binary lands under docs/evidence/, or this upload would make a fourth open PR for the session (drafts and
stale-owned claims count; repairing one of the existing three is allowed). Hermetic: git runs in a temporary
repository; gh and the test runner are fakes.
